audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar Canaan-boundary and land-apportionment text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for south/west/north/east boundaries, Jordan and Salt Sea, nine-and-a-half-tribe allocation, Eleazar/Joshua oversight, and named tribal representatives. Strong anti-colonial and anti-modern-territorial-weaponization safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: Command children of Israel and say to them: When you come into land of Canaan, this is land that shall fall to you as inheritance, land of Canaan by its borders.

familiar.text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

verses.restored: Your southern side shall be from wilderness of Zin alongside Edom, and your southern border shall begin from end of Salt Sea eastward.

familiar.text: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

verses.restored: Your border shall turn south of ascent of Akrabbim, pass to Zin, and its outgoing shall be south of Kadesh-barnea; it shall go out to Hazar-addar and pass to Azmon.

familiar.text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:

verses.restored: The border shall turn from Azmon to wadi of Egypt, and its outgoing shall be at sea.

familiar.text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

verses.restored: As western border, Great Sea shall be for you, and its border; this shall be your western border.

familiar.text: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

verses.restored: This shall be your northern border: from Great Sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

familiar.text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

verses.restored: From Mount Hor you shall mark to entrance of Hamath, and outgoing of border shall be to Zedad.

familiar.text: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

verses.restored: The border shall go out to Ziphron, and its outgoing shall be Hazar-enan; this shall be your northern border.

familiar.text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.

verses.restored: You shall mark for yourselves eastern border from Hazar-enan to Shepham.

familiar.text: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:

verses.restored: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on east of Ain; the border shall go down and strike slope of Sea of Chinnereth eastward.

familiar.text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

verses.restored: The border shall go down to Jordan, and its outgoing shall be at Salt Sea. This shall be your land by its borders around.

familiar.text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

verses.restored: Moses commanded children of Israel, saying, This is land that you shall inherit by lot, which YHWH commanded to give to nine tribes and half tribe.

familiar.text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

verses.restored: For tribe of sons of Reuben by houses of fathers and tribe of sons of Gad by houses of fathers have received, and half tribe of Manasseh has received, their inheritance.

familiar.text: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

verses.restored: The two tribes and half tribe have received their inheritance across Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward sunrise.

familiar.text: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

translation_notes: The chapter maps an ancient idealized inheritance boundary using places whose precise identification is sometimes uncertain.
These borders are not a modern cadastral survey and must not be used as automatic contemporary state boundaries, property deeds, or permission for displacement.
The land is already inhabited within the conquest narrative; geographic precision does not erase the moral problem of prior inhabitants and dispossession.
Allocation is overseen by priestly, military/civic, and tribal representatives rather than one ruler acting alone.
The east-Jordan inheritance of Reuben, Gad, and half Manasseh is acknowledged outside the Canaan boundary described here.
safety_note: Do not weaponize Numbers 34 for modern annexation, settlement expansion, ethnic cleansing, forced removal, or denial of Palestinian, Israeli, Indigenous, or any other people's human rights. Preserve the ancient boundary tradition without turning scripture into a present-day deed of dispossession.
